Passages:

[refunds] Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, annual plans are not refundable, but you can cancel auto-renewal at any time and keep access until the end of the term. Monthly plans are not refundable; cancelling stops the next charge. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically arrive within 5 business days, though some banks take up to 10. To request a refund, open a ticket from the billing page with the invoice number; a billing specialist replies within one business day.

[security-incident] If you believe you have found a vulnerability or that your account has been compromised, email security@ (or use the in-app 'Report a security issue' link) rather than opening a normal ticket. Include what you observed, the time, and any request IDs. We acknowledge reports within 24 hours and do not take action against good-faith researchers. For a suspected account compromise, also rotate your API keys immediately from Settings > API keys and enable SSO enforcement if available.

[billing-cycle] Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each cycle: monthly plans on the same calendar day each month, annual plans on the anniversary of purchase. The billing date cannot currently be moved; if you need invoices aligned to a fiscal month, switch to annual billing and choose the start date when you upgrade. Invoices are emailed to the billing contact and are available under Settings > Billing > Invoices for seven years. VAT is applied based on the billing address; add a VAT number to receive reverse-charge invoices in the EU.
